search_text: published ZDI-15-143 ZDI-CAN-2452 ManageEngine OpManager FileCollector FILENAME File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-04-15 CVE-2014-6034 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-6034 10.0 ['ManageEngine'] ['OpManager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine OpManager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileCollector servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the filenames uploaded to the servlet. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM. ManageEngine has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
